sourceReview: Action/approval readers admit existing SQLite and refuse legacy operational directories; writes stageText only within task transactions.
Action proposal pairs immutable idempotency identity and ACTION_PROPOSED in the same native transaction; native index and column/payload validation remain required.
Approval request/resolution pairs guarded immutable binding, resolution authority and event publication; caller acknowledgment does not become trusted host approval.
Public mutators join withTaskMutation; action-propose forces caller provenance and approval-resolve accepts trusted authority only out of band.
action-show resolves task context then reads and validates one canonical action artifact. Task-selection/action cross-read snapshot coherence is not proven by this reconciliation.
limits: Read-only reconciliation of previously executed named cases; no tests ran during the902resource benchmark.
The3native event-trigger atomicity cases exercise direct domain APIs, not every public action/approval adapter.
Named passing cases do not establish every public dispatch, snapshot interleaving or runtime parameter authority.
Two recovery/command-description production files changed after the retained full Mac run; final current-source prepush/platform checks remain required.
External effect/host authority controls use configured deterministic fixtures; no live publication was attempted.
